title: TUR sent problem report origin
description: Where a sent problem report came from, kept by tur-diag beside its record in $XDG_STATE_HOME/tur/reports/origins/<report_id>.json (mode 0600) when the report is sent. tur-diag report fixed compares it with the running image's list of fixed codes (/usr/share/tur/heal/fixes.json): a report whose code is listed, made on another build, is fixed by the update now running. It is a separate file so that the record format stays unchanged and an older tur-diag, after a rollback, still reads every record. The Rust type tur_diag::report::SentOrigin is authoritative and a test compares the two.

error_code.description: The report's error code, or null.

signature.description: The duplicate signature the receiver files the report under (tur_diag::report::signature).

version.description: TUR_VERSION of the bundle that was sent.

build_id.description: TUR_BUILD_ID of the bundle that was sent.
